content.simple_explanation: 'Gone with the Scooter' is studied by first understanding the main idea, then noticing the evidence, examples and relationships in the chapter.
study_steps: Explain them in your own words.
key_points: Let us Read 2 Gone with the Scooter It was a summer afternoon.
Gopi was sitting in the veranda, reading a book.
Suddenly, he heard something rustling past and falling with a thud in the garden.
Perhaps, it was a mango falling from the tree.
Immediately, Gopi put his book aside, got up, and ran into the garden.
